problem: Creating listings across multiple marketplaces is slow and manual.
business_model: consumer/prosumer app (subscription implied, not confirmed) plus own marketplace

technical_complexity.rationale: Image recognition, pricing and cross-posting via marketplace integrations; mostly integration work using existing models.

defensibility.rationale: Marketplace integrations and LLM listing generation are copyable; many crosslisters already added AI features in 2025.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: One analysis notes marketplaces are adding their own AI listing features; no acquisition or copying aimed at SellRaze found, no shutdown reported as of 2026-11.

market_need_then: Cross-listing across Poshmark, eBay and Mercari is an established paid category (multiple 2025 comparison guides). YC launch post claims 200,000+ signups; site claims 600,000+ sellers (company claims).

identity.visual_style: Product-led dashboard screenshots; design not described by a source.
identity.voice_and_tone: Energetic, direct, benefit-focused short claims (company site).

branding.community_and_virality: Has a Discord community and mobile and desktop apps (company site); one negative Trustpilot review (Jan 2026) called it misleading.

brand_strength.rationale: No source on brand strength found; not rated.

outcome_analysis: SellRaze (Fall 2025, Active) shows fast self-reported user growth for a seven-person team, with a seed from YC, Pioneer Fund and Tekedia Capital per aggregators, but no independent traction or priced round was verified. It sells into a crowded crosslisting category where marketplaces and incumbents add AI listing features, so differentiation on listing speed alone may be hard; the outcome is not yet visible.
